convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'ColorMaRsi-Trigger' custom indicator and #includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library. The custom indicator's buffer logic (buffer 1 returning positive/negative/zero values) must be manually reimplemented in Python. The trade management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory) come from the external .mqh and require manual porting.

other_exits: Buy position closed when trigger signal goes negative (Value[1]<0) and BuyPosClose=true
Sell position closed when trigger signal goes positive (Value[1]>0) and SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot 0.1, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: The core signal comes from a custom indicator 'ColorMaRsi-Trigger' loaded via iCustom. Buffer 1 returns the trigger value: positive = bullish signal, negative = bearish signal, zero = no signal. Entry requires a crossover from zero/opposite to positive (long) or negative (short). The crossover check compares Value[0] (previous signal bar) and Value[1] (current signal bar). SignalBar parameter defaults to 1 (confirmed bar). Separate boolean flags control whether each direction can open and close positions independently (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, and LoadHistory functions.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the ColorMaRsi-Trigger indicator logic in Python. Based on the parameters, it appears to compute two RSI values (period 3 on weighted close, period 13 on median price) and two MA values (EMA 5 on close, EMA 10 on close), then derive a trigger signal from the relationship between short and long RSI+MA pairs. Buffer 1 likely returns the difference or cross state between fast and slow RSI-MA combinations. The signal crossover (Value[0]<=0 to Value[1]>0 for longs, Value[0]>=0 to Value[1]<0 for shorts) is the key logic. Must also reimplement the margin-based position sizing from TradeAlgorithms.mqh or simplify to fixed lot sizing for backtesting.
